title: Autonomous boats to operate on Falcon Lake, Zapata County sheriff warns public to keep distance
excerpt: Self-driving boats provided by the U.S. Department of War will operate on Falcon Lake, and the Zapata County Sheriff's Office is asking the public to keep a safe distance and not approach, board, touch or interfere with them, according to KGNS.
content:
Autonomous boats will operate on Falcon Lake, and the Zapata County Sheriff's Office is asking the public to stay calm, use caution and keep a safe distance from them, according to KGNS.

The boats are being provided by the U.S. Department of War, KGNS reported. They can navigate and operate on their own, without personnel on board.

The sheriff's office says people at the lake may see boats operating by themselves. Officials ask the public not to approach, board, touch or interfere with the boats, to stay alert, and to report dangerous situations or emergencies to law enforcement.

No arrival or deployment date for the boats was given.

Source: KGNS, November 8, 2026.
